events.title: Haunted Happenings
events.description:
Join us for a family-friendly, fun, fall frolic with activities, games, and trick-or-treating throughout the grounds! Costumes encouraged!

Haunted Happenings will also include: 

  • Artmaking Activities: Halloween and seasonal-themed art projects for all 
  • Face painting
  • Lawn Games and Halloween-themed Outdoor fun
  • Create your own Fairy Houses/Gnome Huts in Beach Woods

Need a place to decompress? Head to our Sensory Friendly Space. 

In the spirit of giving, visitors are also encouraged to support the community by bringing nonperishable items for a food drive to benefit the Shelburne Food Shelf.

Admission is $5. Children under 3 are free. Questions? Contact [contact omitted].

Shelburne Museum Members receive free admission and priority entrance to Haunted Happenings. Become a Member or renew your Membership today. Questions about your Membership status? Contact [contact omitted].

Note: After Haunted Happenings events end at 1:00 p.m., the Museum will remain open until 5:00 p.m., including all buildings and exhibitions. To mark the end of the 2026 public season, admission will remain $5 per person for the rest of the day.

events.title: Winter Lights
events.description:
Visitors are invited to bundle up and stroll the museum’s grounds, where iconic landmarks are transformed into a glittering wonderland. Featuring familiar and iconic favorites such as the 220-foot steamboat Ticonderoga and the charming model train village in the Diamond Barn. Each season brings new and refreshed installations. This season features the magical woodland creatures of artist Calvin Laituri in the twinkling pine grove of Beach Woods.

 

Tickets & Pricing:

  • Online advance purchase: $20 adults / $10 children ages 3–17 / Free for children under 3. These are timed tickets, sold for specific time slots.
  • At the door: $25 adults / $12 children ages 3–17
  • Anytime VIP ticket: $35 (Valid for one Walk-through night; no reservation required)

events.title: Sensory Friendly Winter Lights
events.description:
Join us for a gentle, less crowded, supported experience geared towards individuals with sensory needs. Each time slot will have a smaller number of tickets available, meaning you’ll have more space to explore and less dense crowds on the Museum grounds.

Sensory-Friendly elements include:

  • A social narrative
  • Know-Before-You-Go materials
  • Staffing by the Education Team who will greet you and provide assistance and guidance during the event
  • Encouragement to bring headphones, fidgets, and any support materials that you may need
  • Lights and sound are not adjusted, but are gentle and soft throughout the grounds

Please reach out to us with any questions or to talk through any accessibility needs by emailing [contact omitted] or calling [contact omitted].

The next Sensory Friendly Winter Lights is happening on December 14.

events.title: Winter Lights: Drive-Around Night
events.description:
Visitors follow a lead car in their own vehicles on a single loop through the miraculous light displays.

 

Entry times: 4:30-7:30 p.m. on the half-hour. Each Drive-around loop lasts approximately 15 minutes.
 
For safety reasons, visitors must remain in their vehicles for the duration of the drive-around. The caravan will stop at key locations so that visitors can roll down their windows to enjoy the music and take pictures from the safety and comfort of their vehicles.
 
Upon arrival, please present your vehicle’s ticket to a staff member stationed in the circle in front of the Museum Store/Admissions building.
